title: feat(desktop): "Your video is ready" toast after recording (NIW2-584)
body:
## What

Right after a recording, the recording page no longer shows the inline "Your video is ready. Where is it going?" panel that #448 put above the player. It shows the design's toast instead, top-right:

- the success fox (`KaipuLogo use="done"` from `@kaipu/brand`, 42 px), **Your video is ready**, a mono line `3:02 · 1916 × 1048 · 119 MB` (the picture size appears once the file has been read) and a **Master · full quality** tag with a shield icon;
- "Where do you want to send it? We'll shape a copy for that place.";
- pill chips **YouTube**, **TikTok**, **GitHub** and a dashed **··· More places**;
- two equal buttons, **Edit first** and **Open**;
- the footer "Saved at full quality · you can always come back to this".

Linear: [NIW2-584](https://linear.app/niway/issue/NIW2-584/post-recording-your-video-is-ready-toast-replaces-the-inline-panel). Design: Claude Design project `71546ef1-baf5-42e9-8fcc-9b9b44f2c7ab`, [`Kaipu Prepare.dc.html`](https://claude.ai/design/p/71546ef1-baf5-42e9-8fcc-9b9b44f2c7ab?file=Kaipu+Prepare.dc.html), section 1 "Right after recording" (TOAST board).

## Why

The owner found the inline panel out of place on the recording page. The design treats this moment as a toast, not as part of the page.

## Where it lives, and why

It lives in the **in-app status-card stack** (`StatusCardPortal`, top-right of the app window), not in a floating window over the desktop.

When a recording stops, main's `applyStopWindowState` (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts`) already calls `main.show()`, `main.focus()` and `app.focus({ steal: true })`. Then `app-root.tsx` navigates to `/library/:assetId` with `fromRecording`. So the app window is always in front when the toast appears. In that window the stack sits top-right, which matches the design's position. A separate always-on-top window would add a new BrowserWindow, its own IPC and its own preload, and it would show the toast at the same moment and in the same place. I did not build it.

Possible follow-up, only if the owner wants it: a floating window, so the toast can show while the app stays behind (for example a "don't bring Kaipu forward after recording" option). That would build on the capture-panel / control-bar window code in main.

## Behaviour

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| YouTube / TikTok / GitHub | `/prepare/:assetId?to=youtube` / `vertical` / `github` (the destination ids from #448) |
| More places | `/prepare/:assetId` with nothing preselected |
| Edit first | opens the recording in the editor (`useOpenInEditor`); hidden when the recording cannot open there |
| Open | closes the toast, so the user is on the recording page |
| × | closes the toast |

- **It never hides on its own.** The owner liked it staying, and the question is the whole point. It goes away when the user picks a chip, presses Open or ×, or leaves the page (it is portaled from the recording page, so it unmounts with it). Because there is no timer, nothing needs to pause while the pointer is over it.
- It shows once per arrival (keyed on `location.key`, as #448 did), only with `fromRecording`, and only while Settings → Export quality → "Ask where a new recording is going" (`showRecordingSavedCard`) is on.

## Changes

- New `features/status-cards/post-recording-card.tsx` (+ CSS module, tests).
- `StatusCard` gets four additive options, and existing cards are unchanged: `wide` (420 px), `plainIcon` (no tinted tile behind artwork), `badge` (a line under the subtitle), and `StatusCardActions equal` (equal-width buttons). `StatusCardButton` also takes an optional `title`.
- Removed `where-is-it-going-panel.*` and its `prepare.panel*` i18n keys. New copy is in one `postRecording` group in `en.json` / `es.json` (neutral Spanish).
- `library-detail-page.tsx`: only the lines that render the panel changed. The action bar, Send-to button and master badges are untouched (NIW2-585).
- The Prepare backlog doc describes the toast and where it lives.

The "Master · full quality" tag is local to this card for now. If NIW2-585 adds a shared master badge, this card can switch to it.

## Verification

- `bun run verify` passes from the repo root (kaipu-record: 310 test files). One earlier full run had a failure in `video-editor-page.test.tsx` ("discard-changes modal", a timing test this PR does not touch). That file passed when run alone, and the full `verify` re-run was green.
- New tests: the card's content, every chip's destination, More places → none, Edit first, Open and × both dismiss, no Edit first when the editor can't open it, no auto-hide after 60 s. Page tests: the toast shows in the stack after recording, the TikTok chip → `?to=vertical`, More places → no `to`, Edit first → editor, Open / × leave you on the recording, and the toast stays hidden when the setting is off or the page was opened from the Library.
- **Not run in Electron.** Nothing here has been seen in the real app; the owner does runtime QA.

## How to test it yourself

1. `bun run rebuild:native` if `bun run setup` asks for it, then `bun run dev`.
2. Record a short clip and stop it. The app comes forward on the recording page, and the **Your video is ready** card appears top-right: fox, `m:ss · W × H · N MB`, the pink **MASTER · FULL QUALITY** tag, the question, the chips, Edit first / Open and the footer. The page itself has no inline panel above the player.
3. Wait a minute with the pointer away from the card. It must stay.
4. Click **TikTok**. Prepare opens with TikTok · Reels selected. Go back: the card is gone.
5. Record again and try **YouTube**, **GitHub** and **More places** (Prepare with nothing selected).
6. Record again and click **Edit first**. The editor opens on that recording.
7. Record again and click **Open**, and once more with **×**. Each time the card closes and you stay on the recording page.
8. Record again and click **Library** in the sidebar. The card goes away with the page.
9. Open a recording from the Library. No card appears.
10. Settings → Export quality → turn off "Ask where a new recording is going", then record. No card appears.
11. Switch the app to Spanish and record. The card reads "Tu video está listo", "Máster · calidad completa", and so on.
